basis: The chart shows a continuous decline from 23.9°C in 2005 to 10.1°C in 2014, representing a full-period change of -13.8°C. This magnitude of change, spanning nearly the entire visible y-axis range, constitutes a substantial change in the regional summer temperature record. The task requires determining if this change requires substantial-change follow-up. Given the significant magnitude of the change, it is appropriate to route this to substantial-change follow-up.
